FieldSet.description: ALF-RS-11 (LFRDN-341), reusing the LFRDN-342 AF_Document__mdt engine. Fields AF_DocumentConditionEvaluator may reference when evaluating AF_DocumentCondition__mdt rows scoped to AF_Payment__c via AF_DynamicObject__mdt: AF_PaymentMethod__c drives the Cheque Copy/Bank LPO branches, AF_NOCRecorded__c drives the Signed NOC branch (gated on the Cashier's own checkbox rather than a computed payee-mismatch, since the condition grammar has no field-to-field comparison).
FieldSet.label: AF Document Condition Fields
